## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle commentary on the *[Smaller Sukhāvatī](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0082)* is by [智圓](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%9C%93) Zhìyuán (976–1022), the great Northern-Sòng Tiāntái-school *Shānwài* 山外 ("Off-the-Mountain") master, presenting the *Shānwài* reading of the Pure Land sūtra in opposition to the *Shānjiā* (Mountain-Family) line of [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE) Zhīlǐ.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (990 – 1022) reflects [智圓](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%9C%93) Zhìyuán's mature scholarly period.

The Taishō text (T1760) is established on the standard apparatus.
